description: K₃Na₇Mg₂H₁₂S₆(NO₁₈)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal R3 space group. K is bonded in a distorted q6 geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.87-2.99 Å. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.54 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and corners with three SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 79°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.50 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and  a faceface with one MgO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.26 Å) and three longer (2.38 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SO₄ tetrahedra,  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one MgO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.02 Å) and three longer (2.08 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with three equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one MgO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.07 Å) and three longer (2.13 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All N-O bond lengths are 1.26 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All N-O bond lengths are 1.26 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.98 Å) and one longer (1.68 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.68 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.98 Å) and one longer (1.69 Å) H-O bond length. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.68 Å) H-O bond length. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MgO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-47°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.50 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₆ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-52°. There is one shorter (1.47 Å) and three longer (1.48 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Mg and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one H, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one H, and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one H, and one S atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one H, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, two equivalent Na, and one N atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, two equivalent Na, and one N atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms.
